title: Kissed Molten Canadian Duck Casserole
description: A pungent and indulgent Canadian dish featuring duck sauce, perfect for a special occasion, with a low-glycemic twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, saute the mushrooms and green onions in a little bit of oil until they are softened.
In a large bowl, whisk together the duck sauce, egg, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cauliflower rice, shredded cheese, and almond flour to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Add the cooked mushroom and green onion mixture to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Slice the duck breast into thin strips and add it to the bowl, stirring until the duck is well coated with the sauce and rice mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 35 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
